verification.note: Manually compared the source overview and full-color 6720×3328 re3mr sheet. The sheet separates top, middle, ground and tunnels panels, so no global affine is applied. Positions retain source-relative anchors using locally matched room walls, stairs, corridor bends and reactor centers. Hand-picked landmark precision is approximately 2–5 target pixels on ground, 5–10 on inset boundaries; this is artwork registration, not independent in-game spawn verification. Five source-unconfirmed spawns remain unconfirmed. The basement body source point lies outside its drawn inset and retains its relative position on shared ghosted ground geometry; source room/title inconsistencies are not repaired.
